blocks.html: Jesus Christ represents The Spirit of the Antichrist (False Messiah) as it was in the “image of a man who died” in whom The Law of יהוה was abolished. The True Messiah Yahushua declared he did NOT abolish The Torah. In fact, the example he set on this Earth was that of a Torah Obedient Jewish Rabbi. As the chosen Messiah, Yahushua was sent by יהוה to bring The Torah to its fullest meaning and expression spiritually, that is what fulfil means. It does not mean “abolish”.

blocks.html: So, The Torah in the Mosaic Covenant was referred to by the Apostle Sha’ul as The Torah/Law of Sin and Death because it was incomplete, and we were being held captive by the fear of the death decrees.

blocks.html: In The (New) Covenant made with Yahushua the Apostle Sha’ul refers to The Torah as The Torah/Law of the Spirit of Life because the death decrees have been cover releasing us from bondage to ‘sin therefore you die’. The Torah has been fulfilled by covering the death decrees which, the fear of those death decrees had created enmity between us and יהוה. So now יהוה, by removing the death decrees by sacrificing his son in fulfilment of the Avraham/Yitschaq parallel, has now given us a loving heart for His Torah (writing it on our heart) and gave us His Spirit of Set-apartness that teaches us to keep His commandment and obey His Torah, only out of love instead of fear. So now we have ‘The Torah/Law of the Spirit of Set-apartness that leads to eternal life’ because the death decrees are covered by the blood of the lamb… i.e. The Torah/Law of the Spirit of Life! That is the testimony of Yahushua.
